questions.q: What does a Parameter Action let a viewer do that manually moving a slider does not?
options: Set a parameter's value automatically by hovering, clicking, or selecting from a menu on a mark directly in the view
Permanently rewrite the connected data source
Bypass the need for calculated fields entirely
Create new parameters automatically without any configuration
questions.explain: A Parameter Action removes the manual step of operating a control — an interaction with a mark in the view sets the parameter's value directly, using data from what was interacted with.

questions.q: Where do you create a Parameter Action?
options: Worksheet > Actions > Add Action > Change Parameter
Right-click the parameter and choose Show Parameter
The Format menu, under Borders
Parameter Actions can only be created on Tableau Server, never in Desktop
questions.explain: Change Parameter is one of the action types available from Worksheet > Actions > Add Action, alongside Filter, Highlight, Go to URL, and Go to Sheet.

questions.q: In the Edit Parameter Action dialog, what does the "Field / Value" setting control?
options: Which field's value, taken from the mark that was interacted with, gets written into the target parameter
The color scheme applied to the target parameter's control
Whether the parameter accepts All, List, or Range values
The name of the worksheet where the action was created
questions.explain: Field / Value determines what actually gets written into the parameter — e.g. a Benchmark Margin field's value from whichever row was clicked.

questions.q: In the worked example, what happens after a Parameter Action sets the Target Profit Margin parameter?
options: The calculated field referencing that parameter re-evaluates, and any reference line or view built on it updates immediately
Nothing else changes until the workbook is republished
The underlying data source is permanently modified to match the new target
All other parameters in the workbook are automatically reset
questions.explain: This is the same chain built across the chapter: Parameter Action sets the parameter, the calculated field from Lesson 64 re-evaluates, and anything built on it — like the Lesson 66 reference line — updates automatically.

questions.q: Alongside Set Actions from Lesson 61, what role do Parameter Actions play in real dashboards?
options: They're one of the two main mechanisms behind most interactive, click-driven Tableau dashboards
They are rarely used in practice and mostly a theoretical feature
They replace the need for filters entirely in every dashboard
They only work when a dashboard is embedded in an external website
questions.explain: Set Actions and Parameter Actions together are the two main mechanisms that make published dashboards feel like real, click-driven applications rather than static reports.
